note: Enhanced PR Freelance scrape — 7-day window (2026-05-15 → 2026-05-22). Sources: agency career pages (Forefront Communications, Water & Wall Group, StreetCred PR), The PR Net jobs board, Glassdoor/Indeed indexed postings, Crunchbase, O'Dwyer's. Search clusters covered: freelance PR / PR consultant; communications/media-relations consultant (contract/freelance); fractional/interim communications; outsourced/agency-overflow/white-label PR; earned-media consultant / publicist contractor. Deduplicated against pr-freelance-scrape and daily-scrape reports 2026-04-30 through 2026-05-21. Skipped repeats already captured in prior runs, including: Prosek Partners, KCSA Strategic Communications, JConnelly, FiComm Partners, Peppercomm, The James Collective, Mission North, Bospar, BerlinRosen, Highwire PR, Antenna Group, Dukas Linden, Method Communications, M Booth, H/Advisors, Cardinal Communications, Haven Tower Group, Conway Communications, FINN Partners, Crackle PR, Edelman Smithfield, Gregory FCA/BackBay, Infinite Global, The Work Crowd, William Mills Agency, Caliber Corporate Advisers, 5WPR, Cognito Media, Vested, Inkhouse, Reputation Management Consultants. This run surfaces three NEW financial-sector PR firms with active hiring/overflow demand (Water & Wall, Forefront, StreetCred), one dead-center alternative-investments comms boutique as a relationship/monitor target (Gasthalter & Co), and one explicit-freelance posting flagged as off-ICP sector (Hello Human). Aspectus Group was reviewed and EXCLUDED this run: strong financial-services practice but all current vacancies are London/Dubai/Singapore/Aberdeen FT roles with no US or freelance/contract opening. Quality over quantity — 5 vetted leads, all with a real job-posting or careers URL for Mark to review.
